mentions.name: Green Tea
mentions.description: An open source note app built on the Pi agent framework that brings the power of a coding agent harness to knowledge work inside an Electron app. It requires no accounts, and all data stays local on the user's computer.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I’m working on Green Tea. A open source note app built on Pi agent framework. Basically gives you the power of a coding agent harness for knowledge work in an electron app.

No accounts required, all data is yours and lives on your computer.
